title_en: Monday Is Not a Diet Day
description_ru: Самоироничный монолог человека, который каждую неделю начинает новую жизнь с понедельника.
text:
I have decided to start a diet. This is not new information. I have decided to start a diet roughly every Monday since 2011, and so far the main thing I have lost is my enthusiasm.

This Monday, however, was going to be different. I woke up early, did ten minutes of stretching, which my back described as "an act of violence", and prepared a healthy breakfast of oatmeal and blueberries. It looked like something a rabbit would refuse to eat. I sat down, took a deep breath and told myself, "You can do this." Then my phone buzzed. It was a message from my colleague Dave: "Someone brought doughnuts to the office."

Now, I want to be clear that I am a strong person. I have survived three job interviews, two house moves and a four-hour wedding speech by my uncle. But a box of doughnuts is a different kind of challenge. I told myself that I would only look at them. Looking is not eating. Everyone knows that.

By ten o'clock, I had looked at them four times. By eleven, I had learned that the chocolate ones were gone, which made the others suddenly seem much more precious. By noon, I had eaten one, and I explained to Dave that it did not count, because it was a small one and I had been standing up. "Standing calories do not exist," I said. Dave, who has apparently been reading scientific research, said that he had never heard of this.

At lunchtime I ordered a salad, and then, in a moment of weakness, added a side of chips. The waiter looked at me with the sympathy of a man who has seen it all before. "Would you like a salad with your chips, sir?" he asked.

In the evening, I made a new plan. Diets, I realised, should never begin on Monday, because Monday is the most stressful day of the week. Tuesday is not much better. Wednesday is too close to the weekend, and Thursday is too close to Friday.

So I have decided to start on the first day of next month. It is a very good plan. It is also exactly what I said last month.
